newsitem.title: LATVIA: 21PCT SAVINGS BANK ON PUBLIC OFFER - AGENCY.
newsitem.headline: 21PCT SAVINGS BANK ON PUBLIC OFFER - AGENCY.

text.p: Latvian Privatisation Agency (LPA) said on Thursday, that 21,76 percent of the state stake in Savings Bank (Krajbanka) or one million shares will be sold on public offer.
The shares will be on offer starting from March 14 until May 9, LPA spokesperson told Reuters.
LPA approved in a board meeting the regulations for the second stage of Savings Bank's privatisation.
The state owns a 74,54 percent stake in the bank and the remainder is shared between a group of Ventspils harbour companies, SWH and private investors.
LPA has earlier said the the European Bank for Reconstruction and Devlopment (EBRD) is interested to participate in the Savings Bank's privatisation.
